pictures.author: Dudva
pictures.observed: Actually inspected frontal whole cathedral. Unequal stone towers: narrow left clock/upper wood-door stage and wider right tower with two large open bell stages. Pink-gray tapering pierced crowns support small stone caps/crosses. Central pale coral/limestone facade has a wavy stepped Baroque crown,large paired column orders,broken/curved cornices,three rectangular timber portals and small dark floral/oval windows. Selected blind niches have raised scallop surrounds. Geometric columns/niches/volutes carry identity;fine sculpture/interlace/letters excluded.

pictures.author: lin padgham
pictures.observed: Actually inspected elevated front roof view. Main nave behind carved screen has red clay pitched roof. Broad rear red dome has faceted curved surfaces and projecting arched gable-like panels,then a small pale open lantern and orange pointed cap/cross. Unequal front tower crowns are pink/gray stone with small apertures. Surrounding city buildings,temporary construction,sea and wires remain host context. Hidden annex roof partitions and dome/lantern details are approximate.

pictures.author: Ji-Elle
pictures.observed: Actually inspected frontal/plaza oblique whole. Narrow left clock tower and wider two-stage open right belfry frame a broad richly articulated wavy stone screen. Three lower rectangular wood portals,paired columns on two orders,oval/floral glazing,small blind niches,large cornices and shallow broad steps. Adjacent colonnaded city ranges form the plaza but are separate buildings. Their blue wood/shutters/arcades are excluded from the cathedral model.
